messages:
Arjun: quick question — we need an exceptions surface for ephemeral quota slicing across endpoints. chat suddenly tripping per-key burst should not kill rerank/embeddings for the same key.

Sophie: +1. observed a customer hit where a short chat spike dropped embedding calls -> bad UX. can we prioritize by endpoint type?

Mia: we already route by model type in the runtime, but current quota enforcement is per-key global token bucket. no endpoint awareness.

Jon: idea: keep a small per-key-per-endpoint burst allowance that drains from the global bucket but can be recharged independently for critical endpoints (embeddings/rerank).

Sophie: that sounds promising. what about streaming? streaming long-lived connections are different (concurrent vs tokens). we need a separate knob.

Arjun: agreed. propose three axes: per-key global tokens, per-key-per-endpoint burst (ephemeral slices), and per-connection concurrent stream slots.

Mia: sketch of config we'd need in the control plane (pseudo):
```
quota_policy:
  global_tokens_per_key: 100000
  endpoint_slices:
    chat: {burst: 2000, refill_ms: 60000}
    embeddings: {burst: 5000, refill_ms: 300000}
    rerank: {burst: 2000, refill_ms: 120000}
    streaming: {concurrent_slots: 3}
```

Jon: nice. also want a console hint when slices kick in — show per-route slice usage and top offending keys.

Sophie: plus telemetry: we need histograms for "slice_fill_pct" by endpoint and alerts when >90% for 5m. otherwise ops won't notice until customer reports.

Mia: implementation note: runtime should check endpoint slice first, then fall back to global deduct. if slice depleted, allow degraded path depending on policy (reject vs fall back to cheaper model).

Arjun: UX question: should we expose per-key slice editing in console or only via API? enterprises will want UI for carve-outs.

Jon: put in API first, UI later. but add audit log events so sales can request temporary exception and we can track.

Sophie: edge case: canaries that use chat+embeddings heavily for evals — we should allow temp overrides scoped to rollout id.

Mia: agree. add attributes: {scope: key|org|rollout_id} and TTL.

deploy-bot: Deployed quota-service change to staging at 2023-11-07T15:42:03Z (build 0.54.2). Monitor /quota-metrics for new slice metrics.

Arjun: i'll follow-up with a design doc, but wanted quick sync here. main asks: endpoint slices, streaming slots, telemetry + console hints, API for exceptions with TTL and scope.

Sophie: thumbs up. can you include a failure-mode matrix in the doc (reject vs fallback to smaller model vs queue)? ops needs that for SLOs. :thumbsup:
